subject: after the ambush
fact: The events occurred immediately after the gnoll ambush — no time has passed since the last combat, and the group is still in the same corridor, assessing their next move.

subject: After the war began
fact: The events described occurred after the war’s initiation, during its prolonged stalemate, and before the Greater Temple’s authority reveals itself.
source_quote: The wraith had been alone in this corridor for weeks, feasting on whatever the war left behind.

subject: after the Wraith's defeat
fact: The defeat of the Wraith marks a turning point — the passage is now clear, but the faction’s internal rot has been exposed, and the cost of victory is permanent.
source_quote: Two roads to the second level now, and one of them open.

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

subject: Four Nights
fact: Four nights of carrying the specters’ presence, of failing to turn them, of bearing the Wraith’s curse — culminating in the moment of destruction that finally broke the cycle.

subject: Night of Hartsch’s Departure
fact: The night Hartsch disappeared and sent the raid is the turning point of the campaign, marking the collapse of command cohesion and the beginning of the Obsidian Edge’s descent into reactive survival.
source_quote: In the morning he was gone.

subject: Session Date
fact: The Session Date is the moment when the Broken Blades pledged themselves, when Calmer opened the door to his own ruin, and when Hartsch’s name became a silent death warrant — it is not recorded on any calendar, but etched into every soul present.
source_quote: I knew it the moment it left me. The exact word. I could see it land.

subject: session date
fact: The events described occurred during a critical session following the Obsidian Edge’s return to the Earth Temple, marking the turning point in the four-temple war from stalemate to strategic reckoning.
source_quote: We went.

subject: session date
fact: The events occurred during a session in which the party engaged in stealth-based combat, eliminated three gnolls, and shifted their objective from assault to reconnaissance.

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: On the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: The Night of the Failed Raid
fact: The night of the failed raid on the Water Temple was when Hartsch issued false orders, the Broken Blades were slaughtered, the wraith emerged, and the Air Temple’s conspiracy began to unravel.
source_quote: An attack in the night, and it had cost us more than we could spare... Hartsch confessed it in pieces: he'd sent the Blades down to stage a raid on the Water Temple...

subject: Third Time
fact: The third time the party reached for the turning rite — the first two attempts ended in death — this time, it worked. The ritual was not learned. It was remembered.

subject: unknown
fact: The events occurred during an unnamed current time period in the campaign.

subject: Weeks of Feasting
fact: The wraith has been alone in the temple corridors for weeks, sustained only by the dead left behind by the war. This duration underscores his isolation, his patience, and the scale of the violence that has occurred since his emergence.
source_quote: It had been alone in this corridor for weeks, feasting on whatever the war left behind.

subject: Abandonment of Air Temple Assault
fact: The planned assault on the Air Temple was canceled to rescue the Broken Blades after Hartsch’s deception exposed them to lethal consequences, forcing a strategic pivot and abandoning tactical momentum.
source_quote: So the Air Temple was off. You don't run a two-pronged raid when one prong is already pinned and bleeding under the wrong banner.

subject: Ambush at Air Temple
fact: A three-way ambush erupted after Kelno’s recruitment efforts provoked the gnolls, resulting in the deaths of three gnolls and the incapacitation of Calmer, shifting the balance of power in the temple.

subject: ambush of the Air Temple Gnolls
fact: An ambush was executed in the corridor of the Air Temple, resulting in the elimination of three gnolls; the party exploited stealth and concealment to neutralize the threat with minimal damage to themselves.

subject: Battle with the Wraith and Specters
fact: In the Battle with the Wraith and Specters, Calmer unleashed divine light and summoned spirits to cleanse the chamber — the Wraith was wounded, the Specters were destroyed, but Calmer was permanently hollowed by its cold absence, a wound no magic can mend.
source_quote: I felt the floor of myself drop out and knew, instantly and completely, that I was at the very bottom of what a man can hold and still stand.

subject: Bugbear’s Execution
fact: The bugbear defector was slain by Ben in a single, silent strike — not as punishment, but as moral law: betrayal after taking the oath is not negotiable. The act was swift, clean, and final — reinforcing the Earth Temple’s creed.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer called the rite of turning, the call that breaks the dead. The third time.
source_quote: I called it. The light went out of me in a single blast of judgment, and the room of dead things flinched as one.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer could not patch himself past the thin margin he was running on.
source_quote: he could not patch himself past the thin margin he was running on.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer did not heal. I did not run.
source_quote: I did not heal. I did not run.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer felt the floor of himself drop out and knew, instantly and completely, that he was at the very bottom of what a man can hold and still stand.
source_quote: I felt the floor of myself drop out and knew, instantly and completely, that I was at the very bottom of what a man can hold and still stand.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer said, 'Don't mess with me, man! I just killed the Wraith!'
source_quote: 'Don't mess with me, man! I just killed the Wraith!'

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer said, 'I don't need any help to deal with the undead,' quieter, the hint pitched at us and not at them.
source_quote: 'I don't need any help to deal with the undead,' quieter, the hint pitched at us and not at them.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer said, 'It worked! It worked!'
source_quote: 'It worked! It worked!' The words came out of me without permission, without dignity

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer said, 'This is how the earth temple rules, with power and force!'
source_quote: 'This is how the earth temple rules, with power and force!'

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer said, 'Who's the man? Who is the man?'
source_quote: 'Who's the man? Who is the man?'

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer was at the very bottom of himself, one touch from gone, and I knew it. I want that recorded too.
source_quote: I was at the very bottom of myself, one touch from gone, and I knew it. I want that recorded too.

subject: calmer's permanent wound
fact: Calmer suffered an irreversible wound from the wraith’s cold, leaving him with an open door in his chest that cannot be healed.
source_quote: I felt the floor of myself drop out and knew, instantly and completely, that I was at the very bottom of what a man can hold and still stand. And worse, I knew this particular cold does not mend. No light I carry would fill that back in. I was going to walk the rest of this with the door open.

subject: calmer's third turning rite
fact: Calmer successfully performed the rite of turning for the third time, destroying the wraith and all specters.
source_quote: The third time. I called it. The light went out of me in a single blast of judgment, and the room of dead things flinched as one. And they could not hold. The Wraith could not hold. Specter after specter could not hold. They came apart in the radiance, all of them but one.

subject: decision to recon
fact: The group decided the next action would be a recon mission, not an assault.
source_quote: Not an assault. Not yet. 'Recon mission.'

subject: defection of bugbear
fact: A bugbear from the Earth Temple defected with a sack of coins bearing the Air Temple insignia.
source_quote: Air Temple insignia, pressed clean into every piece

subject: dragging Calmer away
fact: Dren dragged Calmer back up the corridor against his protest.
source_quote: Dren dragged him back up the corridor, all protest and no leverage.

subject: Dren Halveth
fact: Dren Halveth asked, 'Do you need our help, boss?'
source_quote: 'Do you need our help, boss?'

subject: Dren Halveth
fact: Dren Halveth said, 'Romag's replacement, Hartsch is a mad man! We're being fed to a meat grinder.'
source_quote: 'Romag's replacement, Hartsch is a mad man! We're being fed to a meat grinder.'

fact: Dren Halveth said, 'You didn't say it would be a slaughterhouse!'
source_quote: 'You didn't say it would be a slaughterhouse!'

subject: emergence of gnolls
fact: Three gnolls emerged from the secret door of the Air Temple.
source_quote: the secret door coughed up its replacements.

subject: Failed Raid on Water Temple
fact: Hartsch launched an unauthorized raid on the Water Temple using the Broken Blades, falsely attributing the orders to the Obsidian Edge, resulting in the Blades being isolated, the temple’s defenses alerted, and the Obsidian Edge’s credibility compromised.
source_quote: I sent the Broken Blades to attack!

subject: Fire Temple attempted entry
fact: The Fire Temple had tried to force an entry and failed, or stopped, or been stopped.
source_quote: The Fire Temple had tried to force an entry and failed, or stopped, or been stopped.

subject: Gnolls’ Revelation
fact: The gnolls emerged from a hidden door after the bugbear’s death, revealing their presence and fury — proving the conspiracy had been watched and funded from within the walls, and that the party had been manipulated from the start.

subject: Greater Temple sealing
fact: The Greater Temple sealed the lesser temples and waits for the battle to end.
source_quote: the Greater Temple seals the lesser temples and waits for the battle to end.

source_quote: Hartsch confessed it in pieces: he'd sent the Blades down to stage a raid on the Water Temple, and heard nothing back.

subject: Hartsch
fact: Hartsch had told them the orders came from us.
source_quote: He'd told them the orders came from us.

fact: Hartsch stopped pretending to be in charge and asked us what to do next.
source_quote: What do we do next?

subject: Hartsch's blunder
fact: Hartsch sent the Broken Blades to attack without authorization.
source_quote: I sent the Broken Blades to attack!

subject: Hartsch's deployment confusion
fact: Hartsch couldn't decide where to put troops or whether to defend or charge.
source_quote: Where should I put the troops? It's all gone to hell!

subject: Hartsch's Impulsive Attack
fact: Hartsch, unable to cope with leadership pressure, secretly ordered the Broken Blades to attack without consultation, abandoning his post and triggering potential catastrophe.
source_quote: I couldn't wait! I sent the Broken Blades to attack!

subject: Hartsch's Unauthorized Attack
fact: Hartsch sent the Broken Blades to attack without consultation, abandoning his command post and leaving a note that read 'I couldn't wait!'
source_quote: I couldn't wait! I sent the Broken Blades to attack!

subject: killing first gnoll
fact: The first gnoll was killed by a dagger strike under the ribs, followed by Zinnia finishing it.
source_quote: the dagger went where daggers go. Thud. Steel through the soft place under the ribs, the full weight of the ambush behind it, and the thing folded most of the way to dead in a single beat. Zinnia drifted in and finished what I'd left twitching.

subject: killing second gnoll
fact: Sequoia killed the second gnoll by tagging it clean and opening it up.
source_quote: Sequoia took the second. Stepped in, tagged it clean, opened it up.

subject: killing the bugbear
fact: The bugbear was killed by Kelno's recruitment actions.
source_quote: Kelno had been recruiting... peeling people off one frightened bugbear at a time.

subject: killing third gnoll
fact: The third gnoll was killed by a third dagger strike from the blind side.
source_quote: Dagger high, dagger low, then the third from the blind side with everything behind it. Thud.

subject: Narrator
fact: The narrator decided the next move was a recon mission, not an assault.
source_quote: Recon mission.

subject: Raising of the Specters
fact: The Wraith used the corpses of fallen soldiers — many killed by the party — to raise seven specters, transforming himself from a passive feeder into an active force with minions.
source_quote: I now have minions.

subject: return to Earth Temple
fact: The Obsidian Edge returned to the Earth Temple after an undisclosed operation, triggering a crisis of command as Hartsch realized his faction had been manipulated into a losing war — leading to a strategic handover from leader to shadow architects.
source_quote: Things have not gone well. Hartsch needs you right now.

subject: Sealing of the Greater Temple
fact: The Greater Temple sealed all lesser temples to isolate the war, trapping all combatants inside until the battle concludes, as dictated by the unseen authority behind the door.
source_quote: The Greater Temple is sealed until the battle is over. No one gets in, no one gets out.

subject: Sealing of the Lesser Temples
fact: The Greater Temple has activated its ancient protocol, sealing all lesser temples — Air, Water, Fire, Earth — to contain the war and await its natural conclusion. The party is now trapped inside, unable to leave until the battle ends or they survive it.
source_quote: The Greater Temple is sealed until the battle is over. No one gets in, no one gets out.

subject: second gnoll's attack
fact: The second gnoll scratched the narrator across the side but did not land a lethal blow.
source_quote: Caught me across the side, hard enough to register, not hard enough to mean anything.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia has been getting funnier the deeper into this place we go.
source_quote: He has been getting funnier the deeper into this place we go.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia killed the bugbear with one clean cut.
source_quote: The first cut found exactly where it needed to go. Clean. He never even turned. It took most of him in the one exchange.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia knew Hartsch had sent the Broken Blades to attack without waiting for orders.
source_quote: I read it twice. Not because it was hard to read. Because I recognized it. 'I couldn't wait! I sent the Broken Blades to attack!'

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia knew Hartsch’s note — 'I couldn't wait!' — was a confession of the same impulse he himself had once acted on.
source_quote: I've decided, on my own, in the dark, that I knew better than the people standing next to me.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia said, 'I think he's okay.'
source_quote: 'I think he's okay.'

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia said, 'One does not simply take bribes to defect.'
source_quote: 'One does not simply take bribes to defect.'

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia stood over the body and said, 'One does not simply take bribes to defect.'
source_quote: I stood over the body. 'One does not simply take bribes to defect.'

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia suspected Hartsch had left because he couldn't wait to act — and he knew he had done the same thing himself.
source_quote: I've decided, on my own, in the dark, that I knew better than the people standing next to me.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia turned a coin in the light because something was bugging me about the weight of it. The stamp wasn't Kelno's. Wasn't water at all. Air Temple insignia.
source_quote: I turned a coin in the light because something was bugging me about the weight of it. The stamp wasn't Kelno's. Wasn't water at all. Air Temple insignia, pressed clean into every piece.

subject: sequoia's execution of defector
fact: Sequoia executed the bugbear defector with a single clean cut, uttering: 'One does not simply take bribes to defect.'
source_quote: The first cut found exactly where it needed to go. Clean. He never even turned. It took most of him in the one exchange. 'One does not simply take bribes to defect.'

subject: strategic pivot to Air Temple
fact: After assessing the relative strength of the four temples, the Obsidian Edge pivoted from defensive survival to offensive expansion — targeting the Air Temple as the weakest point to seize treasure and destabilize the remaining coalition.
source_quote: We'll go after the Air Temple. Take all their treasure.

subject: The Bugbear
fact: The bugbear was babbling: 'Kelno had promised him safety. Kelno had promised him gold.'
source_quote: Babbling. Kelno had promised him safety. Kelno had promised him gold.

subject: The Decision to Camp
fact: The group decided not to camp, instead resolving to leave and return later, after realizing they were trapped and the wraith had already won.
source_quote: Why don't we camp out next door?" I said. Nobody moved toward camping.

subject: The Execution of the Defecting Bugbear
fact: Sequoia executed a bugbear who accepted bribes from the Air Temple, then discovered the coins bore the Air Temple insignia, revealing that the Obsidian Edge was being manipulated by an internal enemy.
source_quote: I said the rest of it before anyone had moved... 'One does not simply take bribes to defect.' ... I went through the sack: twenty gold... Air Temple insignia, pressed clean into every piece.

subject: The Failed Raid on the Water Temple
fact: The failed raid on the Water Temple, orchestrated by Hartsch under false pretenses, resulted in the massacre of the Broken Blades, the emergence of a wraith and seven specters, and the exposure of an Air Temple conspiracy.
source_quote: Hartsch confessed it in pieces: he'd sent the Blades down to stage a raid on the Water Temple, and heard nothing back... Then the door, and behind the door, the slaughterhouse... These were the Broken Blades. We had recruited them.

subject: The Gnolls
fact: The gnolls came out of the wall, talking about money: 'We paid good money for that! Now we will get our money, and get food!'
source_quote: 'We paid good money for that! Now we will get our money, and get food!'

subject: The Recognition of Hartsch's Psychological Collapse
fact: The narrator recognized Hartsch's psychological collapse when he stopped pretending to be in charge and asked for guidance.
source_quote: The moment when a man who has been pretending to be in charge finally stops pretending.

subject: The Sealing of the Greater Temple
fact: The Greater Temple sealed the lesser temples and waited for the battle to end, trapping everyone inside.
source_quote: The Greater Temple seals the lesser temples and waits for the battle to end.

subject: The Specters' Materialization
fact: Seven specters materialized one by one, counted aloud by the wraith, mostly from Earth Temple forces with recognizable insignia and robes.
source_quote: One, two, three. Four, five. Mostly Earth Temple forces. I recognized the remnants of robes, the insignia, the general silhouette...

subject: The Transfer of Authority to Zephyr
fact: Hartsch transferred authority to Zephyr by asking 'What do we do next?' after failing to maintain command during the war.
source_quote: What do we do next?

subject: The Turning of the Wraith
fact: Calmer, wounded and nearly broken, successfully invoked the rite of turning for the third time, destroying the wraith and all its specters in a single blast of divine judgment, ending the choke point’s threat.
source_quote: I called it. The light went out of me in a single blast of judgment, and the room of dead things flinched as one. And they could not hold. The Wraith could not hold. Specter after specter could not hold. They came apart in the radiance, all of them but one.

subject: The War Council at Earth Temple
fact: The war council concluded that the Air Temple was weakest, the Water Temple strongest, and the Fire Temple next, leading to a plan to attack Air first.
source_quote: Who's the strongest? The Water Temple. The weakest is the Air Temple. The next is the Fire Temple.

subject: The Wraith
fact: The Wraith said, 'I was hoping for some Earth Temple blood.'
source_quote: 'I was hoping for some Earth Temple blood.'

subject: The Wraith
fact: The Wraith said, 'Oh, you're back!'
source_quote: 'Oh, you're back!'

subject: The Wraith
fact: The Wraith said, 'What do I get in exchange?'
source_quote: 'What do I get in exchange?'

subject: The Wraith
fact: The Wraith smiled, and it let us pass, and I watched it calculate the whole way through.
source_quote: It smiled, and it let us pass, and I watched it calculate the whole way through.

subject: The Wraith's Final Declaration
fact: The wraith declared his confidence in the outcome, saying 'I can't wait till you come back here! I will be waiting!' with absolute warmth.
source_quote: I can't wait till you come back here! I will be waiting!

subject: The Wraith's Laughter at Calmer's Hammering
fact: The wraith found Calmer's hammering at the door very funny, reinforcing his perception of the group as 'poor little fools'.
source_quote: The wraith found this very funny.

subject: The Wraith's Rise to Collegiality
fact: The wraith shifted from menacing entity to peer-like conversationalist after being acknowledged by name and offered an audience.
source_quote: I gave it that. I could feel the room tilt: the wraith no longer performing menace but something closer to collegial warmth.

subject: travel to Sloobludop

source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: voice from behind the Greater Temple door
